notes.title: More FREE DLC on the way!
notes.content:
Hello all! I just wanted to take a quick minute to let you know that new FREE DLC for Mandy's Room is coming!

As many of you may know, we are already hard at work on Mandy's Room 2. We will have lots more official news about that before long, BUT, we are also currently working a new FREE DLC scene for Mandy's Room.

The new scene will be "Mandy's Fantasy", a scene where Mandy convinces Mr. J. (You, the player) to let her be in charge of YOU this time. That's right. It's only fair. You got to tell Mandy when to speed up and when to slow down, and when it was OK to... finish. And now she wants to do the same for you.

But of course, you know Mandy, she won't be able to just sit there and watch. She won't be able to control herself, and before long she will be... having fun... right along with you.

This will be the frequently requested JOI scene (you can google that term if you are not familiar (warning, its NSFW)) and it will be released as soon as it is finished as FREE DLC for Mandy's Room, meaning all of you who already own Mandy's Room will get the new add-on FREE!

Thanks again for all of your support. You all are the greatest and we look forward to releasing more and more Mandy content!

notes.title: "Mandy's Dream" is here!
notes.content:
[b]"Mandy's Dream" has been released.[/b] It is now included in the "Extra Features" section of Mandy's Room. In "Mandy's Dream", Mandy has a sexy dream that Mr. Jenkins transforms from a cute and fuzzy robot into a real man, and he can finally give her what she has been wanting from him for so long!

In response to feedback and request from our amazing community, "Mandy's Dream" provides more interactivity, and allows the player to directly... ahem, "interact" with Mandy in three unique ways.

Though Mandy's Dream does take a step forward in interactivity, in order to maintain the top quality voice-acted/scripted experience as well as a quality experience for non-VR users, the interactivity is still somewhat limited. There are things to do and interact with using Oculus or Vive controllers, but (and this is important) the "hands-free" style of play is still very enjoyable.

We want to thank everyone for the amazing support of Mandy's Room, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts on Mandy's Dream, as well as future updates and releases.

Now, Mandy is on a secluded beach all alone waiting for you. So what are you waiting for? Get your copy updated and [b]get in there[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33595091/da63537a511ea3e15ab296d0dd75098fe9e70522.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Mandy's Room update for Mid-November
notes.content:
Hello all!

We just wanted to give a quick update and let you know that the "Mandy's Dream" DLC is about 80% complete. We expect to be able to release this DLC on or around December 1st, so stay tuned and thanks for being patient with us. I know a lot of you are as excited about it as we are!

Also, we will be adding more controller functionality to the main game. Nothing too exciting, just the ability to pause, access the menu and recenter the camera using the VR controllers, as well as the ability to say "Yes" and "No" to Mandy with controller buttons, in case you don't want to shake your head.

It's funny, we built Mandy's Room to be "Hands Free", where you shake and nod your head and don't need to have controllers in your hands at all to play, but the number one complaint we receive is "How come I can't do stuff with my controller?". So we're taking your advice and feedback and adding more controller support.

Additionally, the "Mandy's Dream" DLC will include full controller support, including virtual hands that you can use to interact with Mandy during the three fantasy scenes.

That's all for now. Thanks again for your amazing support of Mandy's Room!

Hello all. I want to again thank everyone for the amazing success of Mandy's Room so far on STEAM. We are getting so much great feedback, it's overwhelming. However, the positive feedback in our inbox is not always turning into positive reviews on STEAM, where it really counts.
